006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathException;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
012
013/**
014 * Represents an error that occurs during Metapath function evaluation.
015 */
016// TODO: remove this intermediate exception?
017public class FunctionMetapathError
018    extends MetapathException {
019
020  /**
021   * the serial version UID.
022   */
023  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
024
025  /**
026   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with the provided {@code code},
027   * {@code message}, and no cause.
028   *
029   * @param errorCode
030   *          the error code that identifies the type of error
031   * @param message
032   *          the exception message
033   */
034  public FunctionMetapathError(
035      @NonNull IErrorCode errorCode,
036      @Nullable String message) {
037    super(errorCode, message, null);
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with the provided {@code code},
042   * {@code message}, and {@code cause}.
043   *
044   * @param errorCode
045   *          the error code that identifies the type of error
046   * @param message
047   *          the exception message
048   * @param cause
049   *          the original exception cause
050   */
051  public FunctionMetapathError(
052      @NonNull IErrorCode errorCode,
053      @Nullable String message,
054      @Nullable Throwable cause) {
055    super(errorCode, message, cause);
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with a {@code null} message and the
060   * provided {@code cause}.
061   *
062   * @param errorCode
063   *          the error code that identifies the type of error
064   * @param cause
065   *          the original exception cause
066   */
067  public FunctionMetapathError(
068      @NonNull IErrorCode errorCode,
069      @Nullable Throwable cause) {
070    super(errorCode, null, cause);
071  }
072}
